description: List the files Exeris codegen has generated into this project, each with the generator that produced it and when that generator emits — handlers, services, repositories, domain errors, event publishers, graph projections, sagas, Flyway migrations, OpenAPI specs, and the project-wide bootstrap. Ask this BEFORE hand-writing SQL, a DTO or a controller for an Exeris entity: the build usually already emits it. Optional `entity` narrows to one entity's artefacts. Reports what the pipeline actually emitted, read from its own output manifest and explained by the generator catalogue exeris-tooling publishes with its codegen jar. Each artefact carries `candidates`: every catalogue row that can have written the path, first match first. One candidate means `generator` names it; several mean the path shape is shared and `generator` is null rather than a guess; none means the path is unrecognised. A project that has not run codegen returns present:false.

entity.description: Optional Java simple name (e.g. 'Station'). Narrows to the artefacts whose filename carries that name; project-wide artefacts are always included.

name: build-explain_artefacts
